description_en: This Family Resource Center supports families with a child enrolled at Burnet Middle School and Cook Elementary School who are in transition or crisis by providing case management, support, information, and referrals to community and school resources for parents. During COVID-19, offices are closed, but staff are working remotely with clients. Social workers help promote family stability with direct services and/or referrals to: Basic needs, including food and clothing Access to health and mental health services Housing and rental assistance Employment Family support Legal/Immigration Adult education such as ESL, ABE, GED, computers, nutrition, and parenting classes Assistance applying for utility assistanc,e Austin Energy Plus 1 Assistance applying for state benefits such as Medicaid, CH,IP and SNAP
